evidence.description: The caller-provided date participates in floating-point arithmetic whose result is passed directly to the Int initializer.

candidates.explanation: The projected value is converted directly to Int, which traps for non-finite values or values outside Int's representable range. The public method accepts an unrestricted Date, so an extreme or non-finite date can produce an unrepresentable result without any validation before conversion.
candidates.title: Unchecked floating-point conversion can trap
